summary: Console widget metric desync after org switch (role-based) results in empty timeseries in embedded panels
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that after switching org context via role-based org swap in the Console, embedded dashboard widgets (iframe and native panels) show empty timeseries for metrics that previously displayed data. This occurs intermittently and appears correlated with users who have multiple org memberships and perform a rapid org switch (within ~30s).

Impact:
- Nimbus Health (enterprise) dashboards show blank graphs for up to 5-20 minutes for affected users.
- Alerting annotations still fire but are not visible in the chart.
- Customer engineers are blocked from troubleshooting live incidents via Console dashboards.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Login as a user who is member of two orgs (org-A and org-B) with RBAC roles.
2) Open an embedded dashboard that references org-A scoped metrics.
3) Use the role-based org switch control to swap to org-B and then immediately swap back to org-A (within 10-30s).
4) Observe that several panels in the dashboard render with no series (empty) even though alerts and raw events indicate metrics exist.

Observed behavior:
- Panels display "No data" or render empty series lines.
- Raw usage exports and debug API show the expected datapoints exist.
- Console trace links for affected panels show missing org_id header on subsequent panel refresh requests.

Expected behavior:
- Org switch should not cause panels to drop series for the original org after switching back. Panels should consistently show data for the selected org.

Logs/Artifacts provided by customer:
- Browser network capture (HAR) attached in customer portal (link removed for privacy).
- Console trace id: trace-20260310-9a7c (customer-visible).
- Example dashboard permalink: https://console.redwood.ai/d/xyz123/nimbus-uptime (customer provided).

Temporary workaround suggested:
- Have the user perform a hard refresh of the Console page after switching back to the target org. This restores series immediately in most cases.
- Alternatively open the dashboard in an incognito window scoped to the target org.

2026-03-10 11:03 - SRE (Diego): Reproduced locally using a test account with dual org membership. Saw empty series after rapid org swap. Captured network trace; subsequent panel refresh drops org_id header on request to /api/v1/metrics/query.
2026-03-11 08:45 - Support (Maya): Customer confirmed hard-refresh workaround works. Customer requests ETA for a fix; they have a major incident window tomorrow.

2026-03-12 14:20 - Eng (Anika Shah): Hypothesis: frontend state machine for org context is racing with the panel refresh scheduler. When the context switch overlaps an auto-refresh, the auth middleware sometimes strips the X-Org header for the replayed request. Investigating auth token caching layer and tracing-hook middleware.

2026-03-13 10:05 - SRE (Diego): Added server-side guard to reject queries missing org header when the user has multiple org memberships. This prevents silent empty responses but surfaces 4xx to the UI. Deploying to prod us-east canary at 10:30. Not a full fix but improves visibility.
2026-03-13 16:55 - Support (Maya): Notified customer of canary deploy and provided updated repro steps. Asked them to validate during their incident window tomorrow morning.
2026-03-13 18:22 - Customer (Nimbus): Acknowledged receipt and will test tomorrow. Thank you for the fast response.
investigation_notes: 10-Mar: Reproducible locally using webdriver script performing org swap with <50ms gap. Network traces show panel refresh request without X-Org header (auth middleware returns 200 but empty payload).

11-Mar: Trace analysis (trace-20260310-9a7c) shows dashboard-renderer schedules two overlapping refreshes; the second request is sent with stale Authorization token and missing X-Org due to token rebind logic in single-page-app session manager.

12-Mar: Correlation with recent console release v1.84.2 which introduced prefetching for embedded panel thumbnails. Prefetch code path doesn't attach org header for prefetched requests. Rolling back prefetch is a candidate mitigation.

13-Mar: Canaried a server-side guard that rejects missing-org queries returning 403 with reason 'missing-org-header'. UI currently treats 403 as 'no data' for panels; need UI change to show explicit error message.
resolution: Partial mitigation deployed (server-side guard) to make the failure visible rather than silently rendering empty charts. Root cause: race between org-context swap and prefetch/refresh logic that leads to requests missing X-Org header. Next steps: frontend patch to ensure org header attach is atomic with swaps, revert/adjust prefetch path, and add UI handling for missing-org errors. Planned fixes assigned to ENG-frontend sprint. Target full fix in release 1.84.5.
next_steps: ENG-frontend assigned to produce PR that atomicizes org-context swaps with panel refresh (owner: Anika Shah).
Revert or patch prefetch path to include X-Org header for prefetched metric requests (owner: frontend-infra).
Add UI mapping for 403 'missing-org-header' to render explicit error and not 'No data' (owner: console-ux).
Customer follow-up: schedule validation call after 1.84.5 release.
